description: Run an action count times, each run's modeled randomness seeded on its own, and return the table of the observables with each one's distribution (%runs); or run a Simulation::MonteCarlo analysis case count times on fresh subjects and conclude it.

kind.description: action (default): run an action count times and table the observables; case: a Simulation::MonteCarlo analysis case, run count times on fresh subjects and concluded

name.description: qualified name of the action or case

object.description: for action: the object performing it; for case: its subject

observables.description: for action: the features to table with their distributions; every feature the action holds and the clock when omitted

seed.description: seed each run's modeled randomness derives from; omit for the session's

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: runs

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

rows.description: one per run of a sweep or of repeated runs

error.description: what stopped the run when it failed

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

status.description: holds, fails or unresolved; unresolved is a question the model did not answer (an unknown name, a run that could not be made)

subject.description: what was run or checked, as named

values.description: what the run produced: a calc's result, an action's outputs, a case's outputs and verdicts
